reuse.why: The check is added inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that all five provider link handlers already call.

duplication.why: One query and one throw, defined once; nothing is copied into the provider handlers.

placement.why: The guard sits at the top of the shared linking helper in accounts/app.ts, before any bank, account or sync work, which is where the tree centralises linking.

scope.why: Only the helper and a focused test block change.

maintainability.why: A short, self-explanatory guard in the single linking path; the only nit is using a plain Error where nearby user-facing refusals use APIError.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No provider handler adds its own check; all go through linkBankSyncAccount.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, used by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking link handlers.
